title: onopordum illyricum var. delortii
intro: Onopordum illyricum var. delortii, commonly known as a thistle-like plant, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Onopordum illyricum var. delortii include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and potential antimicrobial agent, making it a subject of interest for further research. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
